notes_body: Encoding page Fig 12.1 [#f-lick_matched_gauss_readout] (docked-spout image; the far-contra columns are on the page). DOCKED ITI: all licks +0.30 [+0.14, +0.44] (4/4) / +0.21 [+0.02, +0.38] (3/4) / +0.27 [+0.11, +0.46] (4/4) mm; first lick of the bout +0.37 / +0.22 / +0.26 (4/4 each); later licks +0.20 (4/4) / +0.22 (3/4, CI includes 0) / +0.28 (4/4).

CUED, all spouts: +0.19 [+0.09, +0.28] acute (4/4), then +0.08 / -0.03 (n.s.); FIRST cued lick +0.35 / +0.22 / +0.16 (4/4, all CIs exclude 0); later cued licks +0.16 (4/4) / +0.06 / -0.05. Far contra cued: first lick +0.67 / +0.31 / +0.11 (chronic n.s.); all licks +0.26 acute, then -0.06 n.s. / -0.28 [-0.39, -0.14] (4/4: read IPSIlesional chronically, carried by the later corrective licks, -0.34 [-0.47, -0.19]).
Script scripts/lick_matched_readout.py --ref gauss (WFIELD_LICK_DECODER=areas_split, WFIELD_ITI_FILTER=dock). Coverage: 97-100 % of licks have a same-place pre reference.

SIGN: + = READ more contralesional than the lick landed (decoder like-for-like offset, a DIRECTION quantity); landing / decoded lateral position + = contralesional; image left = ipsilesional. Decoder: frozen pre-stroke KEY-row lateral lick-position decoder per lick set (z-scored Allen areas with the ALM / tjM1 split, lags 0-0.2 s, August pre sessions, pre scored leave-one-session-out). LIKE-FOR-LIKE offset = each lick's decoded lateral position minus a Gaussian-weighted mean (sigma 0.1 mm, chosen by held-out pre prediction) of the decoded positions of the animal's PRE licks of the same set that LANDED at the same lateral place (any spout, no bins). Session means; change vs the animal's own pre, 95 % paired nested bootstrap (animals -> sessions), * = CI excludes 0, k/n animals. DOCKED-SPOUT ITI = ITI lick onset while the spout is docked (WFIELD_ITI_FILTER=dock: 27,968 of 78,938 ITI licks, 35 %); frozen all-ITI decoder, nothing refit. PROVISIONAL (n = 4).
Licks: LP video licks (cam4 detector) with 3-D tongue position from cam1 + cam4 pose; DAQ licks use the shared detector (daqlk).

notes_body: LICK-ORDER ITI BACKUP. Backup for 'Offset vs lick order: tongue corrects, decoder error stays' (previous slide). Encoding (goal) page Fig 13.2 [#f-lick_order_iti_cued_slope], ITI row (row 1, columns 1-3); slopes of the same data: Fig 13.1. Docked-spout ITI bouts (bout = licks split at gaps >= 1 s). Sign: + = contralesional; lfl + = read more contralesional than it landed. Bars = lick orders where that epoch differs from pre (paired nested bootstrap animals > sessions per order, BH-FDR q = .05 across the 10 orders). Slopes (all spouts, change vs pre per lick): landing +0.100 [+0.051, +0.150] (4/4) / +0.056 n.s. (3/4) / +0.088 [+0.036, +0.162] (4/4); decoded +0.000 / +0.012 / +0.029 [0.000, +0.055]; like-for-like -0.027 [-0.047, -0.006] acute (4/4), then n.s. DOCKED-SPOUT ITI = ITI lick onset while the spout is docked (WFIELD_ITI_FILTER=dock: 27,968 of 78,938 ITI licks, 35 %); frozen all-ITI decoder, nothing refit.
